header.working title: Adapting Schouwen Duiveland Agriculture to Salinisation and Water Scarcity towards 2050: Systemic Barriers and National LVVN Policy Levers

question: How do the actors shape the adaptation of arable farming on Schouwen-Duiveland to salinisation and freshwater scarcity?

actors.label: Arable farmers on Schouwen-Duiveland
actors.interest: Enough fresh water when their crops need it, above all as they germinate, to lower their farms' risk or to raise production. Many want to invest in measures that hold fresh water, once the technique, its costs, its risks and its gain in yield are known for the island's conditions; while supply from outside and measures on the island are both still debated, they hold back.
actors.influence: Decide what the island's farmland grows and how each field is drained, irrigated and supplied with water: in 2025, 200 farms registered on the island grew arable crops on 9,094 ha, of the 13,752 ha of farmland of its 240 farms. A measure in the subsoil can serve several neighbouring farms, which collect and tap its water together; the study of the island's farms explored measures for clusters of one to three. Score 5: they decide the adaptation itself.

actors.label: Waterschap Scheldestromen
actors.interest: Safe dikes and dunes first; then an optimal use of the water system, its ditch levels matched to soil and land use, fresh water kept available where it can and fresh groundwater kept in stock, within costs society accepts. It has no task as a supplier of fresh water: measures beyond its regular water management are for the users of the fresh water to pay.
actors.influence: Sets the island's ditch levels in its water level plans (peilbesluiten: Duiveland 2021, Schouwen 2022), matched as far as it can to soil type and land use such as farming, after a process with the people of the area; sets and enforces the rules for farms' groundwater extraction for irrigation in its waterschapsverordening, a notification within limits per hectare and per well, a permit beyond them. Score 5: it decides binding rules for the island's farms.

relations.description: Sets the ditch levels the island's farms drain to, in its water level plans for Schouwen and Duiveland, and the rules for their groundwater extraction for irrigation.
Takes part with the province in the Zeeuws Deltaplan Zoet Water, and sets up with it a network measuring the boundary between fresh and salt groundwater.

actors.label: Gemeente Schouwen-Duiveland
actors.interest: A vital and liveable countryside, with farming, one of the island's main economic pillars, made climate-proof against salinisation, subsidence and extreme weather, and a reliable water system; water basins on farmland fitted into the landscape.
actors.influence: Its council sets the omgevingsplan, since 1 January 2024 the one plan for the use of all land and buildings on the island, farmland included; its executive decides where a farm may build a water basin outside its building plot; it pays part of farms' advice, research and machines for fresh water and climate-proof farming, and leads the Living Lab Schouwen-Duiveland. Score 5: it decides binding plans for the island's farms.

relations.description: Sets in its omgevingsplan what the island's farmland and farm buildings may be used for, and where a farm may build a water basin outside its building plot.
Pays up to half, at most 25,000 euros, of a farm's costs of advice, research and machines for fresh water and climate-proof farming, from the Living Lab.
Leads the Living Lab Schouwen-Duiveland, in which the water board is a core partner.
Leads the Living Lab Schouwen-Duiveland, in which the province is a core partner.
Leads the Living Lab Schouwen-Duiveland, in which ZLTO and its island branch, Agrarisch Schouwen-Duiveland, are core partners.
Carried out with Deltares the Living Lab's project Samenwerken voor Zoet Water (2020–2022), on storing fresh water in the subsoil.
Carried out with KWR the Living Lab's project Samenwerken voor Zoet Water (2020–2022), on storing fresh water in the subsoil.
Carried out with Acacia Water the Living Lab's project Samenwerken voor Zoet Water (2020–2022), on storing fresh water in the subsoil.
Leads the Living Lab Schouwen-Duiveland, in which Delphy is a practice partner.

actors.label: Provincie Zeeland
actors.interest: Keeping agriculture in the delta, for the fertile deltas' part in world food production, and strengthening nature; enough fresh water and good water quality, worked out with stakeholders in the Zeeuws Deltaplan Zoet Water; groundwater extraction in balance with its recharge.
actors.influence: Sets regional water policy and the omgevingsverordening, whose rules reach the water board, the municipalities, residents and businesses, among them instruction rules the water board's water level plans and the municipality's omgevingsplan follow; sets the water board's tasks and rules of organisation and supervises it; grants the permits for groundwater extraction above 150,000 m³ a year, for drinking water and for open soil energy systems. Score 5: it decides binding rules for the island's farms, mostly through the water board's and the municipality's decisions.

relations.description: Sets the water board's area, tasks and rules of organisation by provincial regulation, sets rules in its omgevingsverordening for the water board's water level plans, and supervises it.
Sets instruction rules in its omgevingsverordening that the municipality's omgevingsplan follows, such as the rule on water basins on farmland.
Co-financed, beside an EU contribution, the Living Lab's project Samenwerken voor Zoet Water (2020–2022), which the municipality leads.

actors.label: Banks lending to the island's farmers
actors.interest: Loans a farm can repay from its cash flow, with its land and other assets as security; an investment whose returns are not yet proven they often count as a risk. In Rabobank's words, to be a partner of the entrepreneur and help farmers invest in sustainability.
actors.influence: Supply 90% of the borrowed capital of Dutch farms (2018), Rabobank about 85% of the lending to the Dutch food and agri sector (2021); they decide whether a farm gets a loan and at what rate, judging more and more by its cash flow and the entrepreneur, as the Basel capital rules steer them towards profitability and liquidity, with land still an important security, and they count sustainability in classifying a borrower. Measured nationally: no source shows the banks' shares on the island. Score 4: they decide credit many of the island's farms depend on, without binding them.

relations.description: Lend to farms: in the Netherlands, 90% of farms' borrowed capital comes from banks, almost 1 million euro of bank loans per arable farm on average in 2018.

actors.label: Buyers and processors of the island's crops
actors.interest: Raw material of the volume and quality their plants and customers need. Cosun Beet Company, owned by its growers as a cooperative, wants the most value from the beet and good long-term returns for its members, its production in balance with its sales; a potato processor secures its supply through contracts that fix a volume and often its price.
actors.influence: Decide what they take from the island's farms, at what price and to what quality. Cosun Beet Company, part of Royal Cosun, the growers' cooperative that also owns the potato processor Aviko, processes all sugar beet grown in the Netherlands: it sets how much beet each member may deliver (for 2026 cut from 100% to 90% of the allocation, after high yields and with sales limited) and advises its growers field by field. The Dutch potato processing industry turns about 4 million tonnes of potatoes a year into frozen products, an estimated 80% of them exported; of the potatoes for the industry, 5 to 10% are sold free and the rest under contract or in a pool (2020), a contract fixing a volume per hectare and often its price, with bonuses for quality and grading and deductions for tare; Aviko, Farm Frites, Lamb Weston/Meijer and McCain are the processors whose contract prices are reported. Measured nationally: no source read shows which buyers take the island's potatoes, onions and vegetables, or their shares there. Score 4: they decide the sales many of the island's farms depend on, without binding them.

relations.description: Cosun Beet Company buys the island's sugar beet, 1,336 ha on 110 farms in 2025, as it processes all beet grown in the Netherlands, from growers who are its members, each up to its allocation; the potato processors buy most of their potatoes under contract or in a pool, measured nationally.

Cosun Beet Company advises its beet growers field by field through its BAS app, from their crop records in Unitip, soil maps and satellite images, in line with the cultivation guide of the IRS, the Dutch sugar beet research centre it works with.

actors.label: ZLTO
actors.interest: The continuity of farming and horticulture and a future for farmers and growers. On the island, more fresh water: in its island branch's words (2023), catching more rain and a collective system that brings fresh water to the island, a pipeline from the Haringvliet shared among the farmers.
actors.influence: The association of 11,500 farmers and growers in Zeeland, Noord-Brabant and Zuid-Gelderland, in 44 local branches that speak for their members to the municipality and the water board; its board appoints the two members for unbuilt land, farmland included, of the water board's general board of 30; it takes the initiative in the plan that carries out the Deltaplan Agrarisch Waterbeheer in Zeeland, with the water board and the province; on the island its branch looks for more fresh water with the municipality and the province, and a report ZLTO commissioned (2023) finds that farming there becomes impossible without more fresh water. Score 3: it shapes the water board's, the municipality's and the province's decisions directly by representing farmers, binding none.

relations.description: Speaks for its members among the island's farmers, through its branch on the island, to the municipality, the water board and the province; its board appoints the water board's two members for unbuilt land, farmland included.

Takes the initiative in the plan that carries out the Deltaplan Agrarisch Waterbeheer in Zeeland, the measures farmers take of their own accord for the water board's water quality and quantity tasks, working with the water board.
Takes the initiative in the plan that carries out the Deltaplan Agrarisch Waterbeheer in Zeeland, working with the province.
